coverage.denominator_definition: Original candidate rows only; held/excluded originals are separately tracked. Unique hymn groups use identical normalized titles plus explicit shared-source catalog memberships, never tune identity alone.

formats: UTF-8 ABC with lyrics and stable catalog-ID JSON/CSV indexes; no project-specific adapter
rights_scope: Source-specific U.S. public-domain assertions and CC-BY4.0 arrangements. Retain credits, licenses and territory caveats. No blanket worldwide publication clearance.
qa_limits: Independent review combines source-content/event audits and visual source/proof overviews; it is not exhaustive human note-by-note proofreading of every edition.
ABCJS6.7.1 semantic parser checks are distinct from browser rendering. Holy dotted ties have scoped6.6.4 browser evidence.
The actual Psalter importer and full browser engraving have not been tested in this conversion task.
Source stanza counts, alternate tunes, omitted appended doxologies, literal/corrected typos and chord-layer choices are explicitly recorded.
